c.title: $3,600 / 3br - Furnished suite in Kits (Kitsilano)
c.description:
Available October 1, 2026

Bright, comfortable, stylish and affordable 3 bedroom home in an amazing Kitsilano location at 6& Vine ground level

This is a great option for looking a cool furnished three-bedroom in an awesome location. The home is well furnished and has a large, private south-facing backyard.

$3,600 /month – utilities included ( if shared between three people equally, that’s 1200 a month!)

• 3 bedrooms
• 1 bathroom
• Furnished- 3 beds, sectional, TV, Dining table chair, chairs, Kitchen basics, decor…
• Large south-facing backyard
• Utilities included
• Free shared laundry
• Free street parking
• Minimum 3-month lease
• Available October 1, 2026

Great location if you’re just moving to Vancouver or you’ve been here for a while, you’ll appreciate how close it is to walk to shops and the beach and transit

The suite offers a lot of space for the price, particularly for anyone who needs three true bedrooms and outdoor space in central Vancouver.

We are local owners who self-manage the property. We don’t live on site, but we’re nearby and available if anything comes up. We have owned the building for 13 years and know the neighborhood and Neighbours well. I’m a mom of 3 busy kids so we are looking for easygoing Tenants that can care for the property.

A small non shedding Dog may be accepted.

Please reply with a little information about yourself, who would be living in the home, and your preferred move-in date/length of stay. I have video of the unit I can send as well. I’m also happy to answer any questions or arrange a viewing
